Question 4
?

Prove that if n is odd, then 3n+5 is even.

If n is odd, then n=
2a+1
2a+1
2a
2a+1
for
some integer a
some real number a
some integer a
some natural number a
.

Therefore,
 
2(3a+1)+1
2(3a+2)+1
2(3a+2)
2(3a+1)
2(3a+4)
2(3a+4)+1
3n+5={(2(3a+1)+1)(S2)}.
Submit
